outerValidationProposal.generic: Enumerate actual generic forSource selection rules over all 148 contexts, not metadata-only 88 routes.
outerValidationProposal.explicit: Enumerate pack.steps plus pack.details and five Rust topics with full topic-specific claims and support contexts; retain source-versus-related example distinction.
outerValidationProposal.closure: Cross-check producer invocation sites against inventory plus rendered routes; each consumer must resolve its original source and original teaching claims.
outerValidationProposal.negative: Contained source bytes are not claim equivalence. Zero consumers must be demonstrated against actual adapters, never inferred from missing metadata records.
outerValidationProposal.gates: Require UI route reachability, source-fit and fallback on raw fetch failure; metadata flag alone cannot pass.

conclusion: All six excluded contexts are actively consumed by generic source viewer; four also have explicit legacy/Rust consumers. Three unique ranges have no Atlas direct option or containing indexed source. A previous globally-unused assertion was false.
semanticsLimits: This diagnosis proves actual consumers and missing discoverability, not a fresh semantic approval of all six contexts or equivalence between generic and topic claims.
